assessments.reasoning: The survey captures individual marital status (Bloque IV, Col 07), relationship to head (Bloque IV, Col 03), and external support/remittances (Bloque V, item 12), enabling de jure female heads (soltero/a, separado/a, divorciado/a, viudo/a) to be distinguished from de facto female heads (married/partnered female head without a spouse present in the household roster). Individual labor and non-labor income are recorded for each individual member 10 years and older (CuestIndividual and CuestHogar Bloque VI), allowing identification of the primary earner/provider (women-maintained household/unit) regardless of who is designated as the reference person/head. However, relationship to head (Col 03) is recorded only in relation to the designated household head, meaning parent-child links cannot be constructed for non-head mothers inside larger households to identify unpartnered mother-child units. Additionally, care, consumption, and production tasks are collected only at the household level (Bloque VII), not for sub-household mother-child units.
